## Summary

Describe the problem, the approach, and the user-visible behavior.

## Type of change

- [ ] feat
- [ ] fix
- [ ] security
- [ ] perf
- [ ] refactor
- [ ] docs
- [ ] test
- [ ] build/chore

## Verification

List the exact commands and environments used. Separate unit/fixture evidence
from real operating-system, real OAuth provider, or real MCP-client acceptance.

## Security review

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, device identities, databases, backups, or private
      deployment data are included.
- [ ] Authorization and permission behavior is unchanged, or the change is
      explained below.
- [ ] Security-sensitive failure paths have negative tests.
- [ ] Privileged behavior was tested only in an authorized isolated environment.

Security boundary notes:

## Compatibility

Describe protocol, installer, configuration, database, and upgrade compatibility.
If none, write "No compatibility impact."

## Documentation

- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented.
- [ ] Platform/client support claims match actual acceptance evidence.
- [ ] Changelog entry is included when appropriate.

## DCO

- [ ] Every commit includes a Signed-off-by trailer.
